Investment

Investissement durable

An investment approach integrating environmental, social, and governance (ESG) criteria into portfolio construction and management to generate long-term value and support responsible business practices, in line with global frameworks (CFA Institute, UN PRI, MSCI, GIPS).

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Investissement durable?

In this glossary, Investissement durable refers to: An investment approach integrating environmental, social, and governance (ESG) criteria into portfolio construction and management to generate long-term value and support responsible business practices, in line with global frameworks (CFA Institute, UN PRI, MSCI, GIPS).

How is Investissement durable used in finance?

In finance communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Les mandats d'investissement durable exigent que les gestionnaires de fonds prennent en compte les risques et opportunités ESG à toutes les étapes du processus d'investissement."

Investissement durable matters because it supports clear communication in Investment contexts for Financial Analysts, Bankers, and Traders. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as CFA, ACCA, and FRM.

Definition

An investment approach integrating environmental, social, and governance (ESG) criteria into portfolio construction and management to generate long-term value and support responsible business practices, in line with global frameworks (CFA Institute, UN PRI, MSCI, GIPS).

Operational example

Sustainable investing mandates require fund managers to consider ESG risks and opportunities in all stages of the investment process.
